summary: Malheur NF pole platform built 1930, abandoned in the 1940s; last reported standing in May 2021; closure notice for 2024 fires; current state unknown.

facts.status_note: Last reported standing in May 2021. A closure notice from July 2024 is on that visit report; no later report found.

access.note: A notice on a 2021 visit report says the area was closed as of July 14, 2024, because of the Falls and Telephone fires. No later notice found.

visit.trail_note: 2021 visitor parked near where the road was blocked by large rocks and walked to the summit. Check the closure first.

events.note: Built as a 15-foot platform observation tower (register); 'pole platform tower' in 2021 visit report

evidence.supports: built in 1930 as a 15-foot platform observation tower
evidence.quote: This lookout was built in 1930 as a 15-foot platform observation tower.
The platform was still standing as of May 30, 2021.

evidence.supports: never upgraded and abandoned in the 1940s
evidence.quote: The site was never upgraded to a more substantial structure and was abandoned in the 1940s.

evidence.supports: possible emergency use, little written about it
evidence.quote: but there is little to no information online about it

evidence.supports: fallen into disrepair but still stands
evidence.quote: It has fallen into a state of disrepair but still stands.

evidence.supports: closed as of July 14, 2024 for the Falls and Telephone fires
evidence.quote: As of July 14, 2024 this area is currently closed due to the active Falls Fire and Telephone Fire.

evidence.supports: road blocked by larger rocks; walked to summit
evidence.quote: the road was blocked off by larger rocks

evidence.supports: walked to summit along a game trail
evidence.quote: took us directly to the summit

corrections.why: The register and a May 30, 2021 visit report both say the platform still stood then. No source says it has come down since, though the closure notice means no one has confirmed its condition since 2021.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The record's 'gone' conflicts with the register's statement that the platform was standing in 2021. Resolved as standing when last reported; see corrections for the human review.

notes_for_editor: Elevation conflicts: the register gives 5,948 ft (1,813 m), which is the record value; firelookout.com and the 2021 visit report give 6,025 ft (about 1,836 m). Left unchanged. No source describes the site after May 2021. The closure notice (July 2024) may have ended. The register's photo is all rights reserved, so no photo added. Staff and fires: none in sources.
